verdict.rationale: Version pinning is a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Brewfiles as a per-project list of which packages to install, and `brew bundle dump` as a snapshot of installed packages. Nothing documents pinning exact versions in a Brewfile or having Homebrew enforce such pins. Community reports point the same way: one user cites 'mandatory upgrades that I couldn't pin', and another wishes for a standard way to install multiple versions of node, php and Python.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin exact versions of packages and tools per project and have the manager respect those pins
